---
title: "Census Maps"
---

## Sarasota County population by age

Each dot represents about 100 residents and is placed within its census tract.
Dots show estimated population counts, not individual people's locations.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(tidycensus)

library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

sarasota_tract_age <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  state = "FL",
  county = "Sarasota",
  table = "B01001",
  year = 2024,
  geometry = TRUE
)

age_groups <- c(
  "Under 18", "18-24", "25-34", "35-44",
  "45-54", "55-64", "65+"
)

sarasota_tract_age <- sarasota_tract_age |>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(3:6, 27:30))) ~ "Under 18",
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(7:10, 31:34))) ~ "18-24",
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(11:12, 35:36))) ~ "25-34",
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(13:14, 37:38))) ~ "35-44",
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(15:16, 39:40))) ~ "45-54",
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(17:19, 41:43))) ~ "55-64",
      variable %in% paste0("B01001_", sprintf("%03d", c(20:25, 44:49))) ~ "65+"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME, age_group) |>
  summarize(estimate = sum(estimate), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(dot_count = floor(estimate / 100)) |>
  filter(dot_count > 0) |>
  sf::st_transform(26917)

sarasota_outline <- sarasota_tract_age |>
  distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_geometry() |>
  sf::st_union() |>
  sf::st_sfc(crs = 26917) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326) |>
  sf::st_sf()

set.seed(123)
dot_geometry <- do.call(
  c,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(sarasota_tract_age)), \(i) {
    sf::st_sample(
      sarasota_tract_age$geometry[i],
      size = sarasota_tract_age$dot_count[i]
    )
  })
)

age_dots <- sf::st_sf(
  age_group = rep(sarasota_tract_age$age_group, sarasota_tract_age$dot_count),
  geometry = dot_geometry
) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)

age_colors <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#6A3D9A", "#1F78B4", "#33A02C", "#FF7F00", "#E31A1C", "#A65628", "#666666"),
  domain = age_groups
)

leaflet() |>
  addPolygons(
    data = sarasota_outline,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = "#444444",
    weight = 2
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = age_dots,
    color = ~age_colors(age_group),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    radius = 3,
    stroke = FALSE,
    label = ~age_group
  ) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = age_colors, values = age_groups, title = "Age group")
```
